Lanjutkan satu file per fase.

## Prinsip utama

- Python-first
- Flask + Jinja2
- No TypeScript
- No React / Next.js
- Minimal JavaScript
- Data-driven projects
- One reusable project renderer
- Reusable architecture renderer
- Detective room as storytelling layer
- Technical content remains primary
- Never invent unsupported project facts
- Every phase must be verified before the next phase begins
